notes.title: Get Your Art Featured In Sophistry Live2D Visual Novel!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39847720/34a20517fdf454dcfeb93c60e3d993fdb76a17ab.png

Get Your Art Featured In Sophistry Live2D Visual Novel!

View the event on Facebook 

★★CONTEST RULES:★★

✧ The theme of the contest is simple: Romance!

✧ Draw any of our character or combination of characters of Sophistry, just make sure that your entry evoques romance, in some capacity.

✧ While Sophistry is rated M (17+), it's not a hentai or eroge VN, so please keep your entries within that rating.

★★SUBMISSION DETAILS:★★

✧ This contest will run from February 14th -February 28th.

✧ To submit entries you need to post your art on Facebook in comment of this post.

✧ You can enter as many times as you want, but you can only win once.

★★PRIZES:★★

✧ The top 5 entries will be featured in our VN in a more or less prominent way (along with due credits of course!).

✧ Showcase on our social media pages.

★★SELECTION:★★

✧ After the submission deadline (Feb 28th), all the valid entries will have 1 week (until March 7th) to gather as many likes as possible. The top 5 entries with the most likes will be considered the winners.
